text: Run tasks per package with filters: `pnpm --filter @lumen/ui test`, or `pnpm turbo run test --filter=@lumen/ui...` to include its dependents.
Any change to a published package under packages/ needs a changeset (`pnpm changeset`); CI fails the PR without one.
New ui components must be exported from packages/ui/src/index.ts and have a story; the component docs are built from Storybook.
UI tests use Vitest and Testing Library on jsdom. Every interactive component gets an a11y check with vitest-axe's toHaveNoViolations.
Use the design tokens in packages/ui/src/tokens (spacing, color). Hard-coded px values fail the token lint rule.
The ui package handles dates with date-fns v4 and takes Date objects. Don't call toLocaleDateString inside components; accept a locale prop.
Storybook: `pnpm --filter @lumen/ui storybook` (port 6006). Interaction tests run with `pnpm --filter @lumen/ui test-storybook`.
apps/web uses @lumen/ui through workspace:*. After changing ui exports, restart the web dev server; Next caches the transpiled package.
Overlays (Popover, Dialog) are built on Radix primitives. Don't add a second headless library such as Headless UI.
The ui package is built with Rollup: run `npm run build` inside packages/ui.
packages/ui builds with tsup (`pnpm --filter @lumen/ui build`); the Rollup config was removed.
Dates are handled with moment.js across the repo.
apps/api is a Hono server on port 8787. Route handlers live in apps/api/src/routes and are validated with zod-openapi.
apps/api stores data in SQLite through drizzle; run migrations with `pnpm --filter @lumen/api db:migrate`.
Packages are released from main through the Changesets 'Version Packages' PR; never run `changeset publish` locally.
Node 22 and pnpm 9 are pinned through packageManager and .nvmrc; run `corepack enable` once per machine.
apps/web auth uses Auth.js with the GitHub provider in dev; production uses SSO only.
Email templates in packages/emails render with react-email; preview them with `pnpm --filter @lumen/emails dev`.
Commit scopes match package names: feat(ui), fix(api), chore(web).
packages/ui is styled with styled-components.
packages/ui styles are CSS Modules plus tokens; styled-components was removed in ui v2.
The Turbo remote cache is on in CI only; locally it's optional (set TURBO_TEAM and TURBO_TOKEN if you want it).
apps/web feature flags come from the flags service at /api/flags and default to off in preview deployments.
Bookings are in the venue's timezone: convert with venue.tz before sending dates from apps/web to the API.
